title: The Sea Flipping Seal
summary: Xie Biyan's Blood Soul Art forces Little Fairy Doctor to unseal her Woeful Poison Body, and she traps him in a Sky Poison Prison. Xiao Yan fights Xie Shan and his Four-Wing Scorpion. Zi Yan sets a trap, and Xiao Yan kills Xie Shan with an Octane Blast, which scatters the Ten Thousand Scorpion Gate's men. Protector Tie devours spirit forms from his soul lamp to grow stronger against Medusa. Xiao Yan, covered by Zi Yan, condenses the Sea Flipping Seal once and smashes him. Protector Tie wonders if Xiao Yan is from the Gu Clan and tries to flee. Medusa corners him, and he threatens them with the Hall of Souls.
